definition: Awarded each week to the losing team with the highest projection-based win probability at the first Monday Night Football kickoff.
capturePoint: The automation records ESPN live projected totals during the 15-minute window before the first Monday Night Football game begins, then derives a consistent win probability.
probabilityMethod: 100 ÷ (1 + e^(-(team projected total − opponent projected total) ÷ 12))
